build_SparseRoIHead: build a SparseRoIHead instance with 6 iterative stages and DIIHead bbox configuration for Sparse R-CNN detection
run_bbox_loss: run the bbox_loss method to compute classification scores and bounding box regression loss for a given stage
run_mask_loss: run the mask_loss method to compute mask prediction loss using attention features and sampling results
run_predict_bbox: run predict_bbox to perform iterative forward propagation and return detection results with scores and labels
run_predict_mask: run predict_mask to generate instance segmentation masks from bbox predictions and attention features
